FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Yield Reversal Offsets Overbought RSI as US Equities Hit Records
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades at 157.83, maintaining a strong position above its 20-day moving average of 156.26.
US Treasury yields reversed higher, providing fundamental support for the US dollar despite soft jobs data.
RSI(14) at 76.34 indicates overbought conditions, suggesting potential consolidation or a pullback toward the MA20 before resuming the uptrend.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY bullish above MA20 at 156.26. Rising US yields and record equities support the uptrend, despite overbought RSI at 76.34.
FX.comment: USD/JPY remains bullish above the 20-day MA (156.26) as rising US yields and record equity indices support the pair, despite overbought RSI at 76.34.
